summary.text: Hanson is a Chicago-born small business owner who works in commercial real estate and has run for this seat in several earlier cycles. He won the March 2026 Republican primary. His campaign website describes him as a "Liberal Republican – fiscally conservative/socially liberal."

paragraphs.text: Born in Chicago, Illinois, and lives in Illinois.
According to his campaign website, he began his career selling advertising for the Chicago Tribune and later U.S. News & World Report, and now works selling and leasing commercial real estate.
Describes himself as owning a small business; Ballotpedia lists his profession as business owner.
Was the Republican nominee for this seat in 2018, 2020, 2022 and 2024 and lost each general election to Mike Quigley; he won the Republican primary in each of those years.
Won the Republican primary on March 17, 2026, and is on the November 3, 2026 general-election ballot.
